finding.headline: "The Language-Lonely Newcomer"
finding.problem: "I delivered and cared for my baby completely alone. In my country my mother would be here 40 days. Here no one speaks my language. I am so lonely I cry."
finding.person: Refugee/immigrant African mum (e.g., Sudanese, Somali, Nigerian newcomer) who speaks little English, with no one to talk to in her language; longs for her home village's 40-day care (BMC Pregnancy; Black African Newcomer Women, Canada).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Your Voice, Your Village: Finding Language & Faith Community as a New Mum."". Verdict: PASSES.
